title: Encyclopaedia of Indian Literature: Sasay to Zorgot (entry on Subramania Bharati)

verification.verification_notes: Sahitya Akademi encyclopedia entry documented as the source for Bharati's dates (1882-1921), Tamil-medium reformist and patriotic poetry, Nondi Chindu metre, and anti-caste and women's-emancipation themes; encyclopedia not inspected page-by-page, identity confirmed via citation records and Tamil Virtual University.

limitations: Bharati's poems are Tamil; prosody and register claims rest on secondary description, not original-language analysis.
